name: Jiamei Food Packaging (Chuzhou) Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiamei Food Packaging (Chuzhou) Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of food and beverage packaging containers in China. The company offers three-piece, two-piece, ABC, TBC, and SBC cans; tinplate printing; and aseptic paper packaging services. It also provides beverage filling and bottling services.
